fullContentHtml:
Bihar BPSC APO Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the admit card for the posts of Assistant Prosecution Officer (APO). This recruitment has been announced for 300 posts. The online application process for BPSC APO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 February 2026, to 20 March 2026. The Examination is going to conducted on 15 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for BPSC APO Admit Card 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 February 2026
  • Last Date : 20 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 15 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Available Soon

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Bihar BPSC APO Admit Card 2026?

Bihar BPSC APO Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 20 March 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://bpsc.bihar.gov.in/

How to download admit card?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
